name: InkToPaw 3D Model Block
author: inkeddev

sections.description:
InkToPaw 3D Model Block adds a lightweight 3D model viewer block for WordPress. It is built for creators who want simple Gutenberg-native display for GLB and GLTF models without a heavy builder workflow.

The block includes presentation controls for background style, material preset, exposure, shadow intensity, sizing, border radius, camera controls, auto rotate, and showcase details. It can help plain, stock, or unmaterialed GLB and GLTF models feel more presentable with cleaner staging and viewer defaults.

Supports standard GLB and GLTF model viewing. For best compatibility, export files with uncompressed geometry and standard textures.

InkToPaw 3D Model Block is free forever. There is no pro tier, no paywall, and no locked upgrade path for the core creative display experience.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inktopaw-3d-model-block folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Add the 3D Model block from the Media block category.
  4. Choose a GLB or GLTF model from the media library and adjust the block settings in the editor sidebar.
sections.faq:
Is InkToPaw 3D Model Block free?

Yes. InkToPaw 3D Model Block is free forever, with no pro tier and no paywalls.

What model formats does InkToPaw 3D Model Block support?

InkToPaw 3D Model Block supports standard GLB and GLTF model files. For best compatibility, use uncompressed geometry and standard textures.

Can it help simple stock models look better?

Yes. The block includes simple presentation controls for backgrounds, lighting, shadows, sizing, and showcase options, so plain or stock GLB and GLTF files can be displayed with a cleaner frontend presentation.

Does InkToPaw 3D Model Block require a page builder?

No. InkToPaw 3D Model Block is a Gutenberg-native block.

Does InkToPaw 3D Model Block load remote viewer scripts?

No. InkToPaw 3D Model Block bundles the model-viewer runtime locally. Version 1 is for standard GLB and GLTF viewing. Draco, Basis, KTX2, and WebAssembly decoder assets are not bundled.

Who is InkToPaw 3D Model Block for?

InkToPaw 3D Model Block is for creators who want a simple, lightweight way to display 3D models in WordPress.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
  • Adds a Gutenberg-native 3D Model block for standard GLB and GLTF files.
  • Bundles the model-viewer runtime locally without remote viewer scripts.
  • Adds editor controls for background, material preset, exposure, shadow intensity, sizing, border radius, camera controls, auto rotate, and showcase display.
  • Includes clean frontend presentation defaults for plain, stock, or unmaterialed GLB and GLTF models.
